data.title: Kioku no Fuchi
data.synopsis:
An old woman is walking in a dimly lit town. The road is muddy, and every house was closing its windows. She stopped suddenly in front of the coffee shop. When she came across the shopkeeper, she realized that he was an old lover who was separated by war.

(Source: Official Site)

data.title: Micchan
data.synopsis:
In a world where it has become quite difficult for people to see each other in real life, the virtual SNS "Virtuapia" is becoming the standard for social interaction. Akane, a fourth year university student, meets up with her childhood friend and best friend, Micchan, who has been absent from Virtuapia for a long time…

(Source: Official Site)
data.background: Graduate Work 2021 by Tadao Morohashi, Musashino Art University.

data.title: Krasue
data.synopsis:
In a town of South-East Asia, at night, a Yakuza is facing a bloody conflict with local gangs. During the fight, he encounters with a ghost called Krasue (pronounced Gasoo), a flying woman head with her guts exposed, and is followed by her because of his blood's taste. Their battle eventually leads them to the depth of a dark and damp maze-like jungle, where boundaries between humans, animals and ghost seem to fade. With a howling noise, "BOY MEETS GIRL" metamorphoses into "Encounter with another species."

(Source: New Chitose Airport International Animation Festival)

titles.title: ねんどろいど15周年 Anniversary PV

data.title: Nendoroid 15-shuunen Anniversary PV
data.title_japanese: ねんどろいど15周年 Anniversary PV
data.synopsis:
February 2021 marks the 15th anniversary of the Nendoroid series! This video is to celebrate 15 years of Nendoroids! We hope you enjoy it!

A total of 20 characters from the "Nendoroid" series are featured in this stop motion video - showing the Nendoroids as they all come to life at night when everyone is asleep!

The film was produced by the stop-motion animation production studio Dwarf, which has produced a number of famous stop-motion works.

(Source: GOOD SMILE CHANNEL)

data.title: Hair Album
data.synopsis: A grey-haired woman is a customer at a hair salon. As her hair is being cut, the clippings on the floor form characters and start to move as memories of her past.
data.background: A promotional video for Takara Belmont Corp., a Japanese manufacturer of hairdressing equipment. The video won Ciclope Asia 2021 award in the animation category as well as the Brain Online Video Award.
